title: PickSword
description: this is a sword that is also a pickaxe. The best of both worlds!
body:
# PickSword Mod

Ever been stuck choosing between your trusty pickaxe and your powerful sword? With the PickSword Mod, that problem is a thing of the past!

The PickSword combines mining efficiency and combat power into a single versatile tool. Mine stone, ores, and other blocks with the speed of a pickaxe, then instantly switch to taking on hostile mobs without changing items. Whether you're exploring deep caves, raiding ancient structures, or gathering resources, the PickSword keeps everything you need in one slot.

Crafted using familiar Minecraft materials, the PickSword is available in multiple tiers, including Wooden, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite. Each tier offers balanced mining speeds and attack damage to fit naturally into vanilla gameplay while providing a fresh and convenient experience.

This mod is perfect for players who want a streamlined adventure, reduced inventory clutter, and faster reactions during unexpected encounters underground. No more scrambling through your hotbar when a Creeper sneaks up while you're mining!

Designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft, the PickSword Mod maintains the game's classic style while adding a fun and practical new tool for survival, multiplayer, and exploration.

One tool. Two purposes. Endless possibilities.
